title: Palantir full assessment blocked by same-run provenance ambiguity
description: The required schema-v2 assessment for security_bdc2f87dadf134760c3a was rejected before assessment state changed because the deterministic assessment applier found both the completed quick_check_research operation 01KZ8BGD98PKED1HFZEE390H75 and the current security_research operation 01KZQYAY286JRATAH6EKE2E9AZ claimed by run daily-20260811T075824Z and cannot select a unique source operation. Wiki conclusions were restored, no idea or strategy follow-up was enqueued, and the operation must fail closed until the controller schedules the full review under a distinct run or deterministic provenance selection is repaired.
